hooks.text: Before their civilization collapsed, the Nazca cut down their own desert defense.
Why did a brilliant ancient society destroy their own desert defense?
The Nazca carved massive lines but destroyed their own desert defense.

title: Why Did the Nazca Cut Down Their Own Desert? 🗿
description: Discover the tragic mystery of the Nazca civilization, whose reliance on agriculture and clearing of native trees led to their sudden collapse.
